description: celbom/v1 — Declarative-rules composer: the BOM of teams x a rule set generates the children DAG. Unlike stdstarlark (a Starlark PROGRAM in the bundle), celbom's composition is RULE DATA + one-line CEL `when` predicates in the providerconfig SPEC — structured, queryable, validatable config, not an opaque blob. The fan-out loop is fixed Go; CEL (non-Turing-complete) is only the per-rule team selector. Editing a rule is a config edit + recompose, no converge redeploy.

name.description: Deployment instance name; the prefix for composed child names.

config_schema.description: The DECLARATIVE rule set. Each rule selects teams by a CEL `when` predicate over the `team` variable {fd, name} and stamps out a child from a template. This is plain queryable JSON in the providerconfig spec — the point of the CEL approach vs an opaque program.

name.description: Rule name; also the ${name} placeholder + the child's spec.policy.

when.description: CEL boolean over `team` {fd, name}, e.g. team.fd == "fd-00". Empty = always.

kind.description: Child resource kind to compose (must have an applied CRD).

kind_version.description: Child web-API version (v1, v2, …). REQUIRED — no implicit v1 default.

spec.description: Optional LITERAL spec fields baked into the child — the team-specific inputs a kind needs beyond the (fd, team) identity, e.g. a faketerraform's {"tar_url": "s3://.../base.tar"} or a fakek8sjob's {"image": "nginx:1.27"}. Merged onto the identity (literal wins); string values support ${fd}/${team}/${name}.

depends_on.description: Optional: zero or more UPSTREAM children (per team) this rule's child depends on; each emits a DepEdge carrying value flows. The engine schedules the upstreams first and flows their statuses into the child's spec before the child runs.

items.description: One upstream dependency + its value flows.

kind.description: Upstream child kind (must have an applied CRD).

kind_version.description: Child web-API version (v1, v2, …). REQUIRED — no implicit v1 default.

name.description: Upstream child name template; same placeholders as child.name.

spec.description: Optional LITERAL spec fields for the upstream (same semantics as child.spec), e.g. a faketerraform upstream's tar_url. The flowed field this upstream PRODUCES is left absent.

flow.description: Value flows: each fills the dependent's spec[to] from the upstream's status[from]. Fields are JSON Pointers ("/vpc_id").
